messages:
pagerbot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool latency spike detected for customer TidalCorp (pool: tidal-eu1-dedicated). p95=430ms (SLO=200ms), p99=1.25s. Error rate ~0.3%. Traffic concentrated on tenant-tdc-42. Autoscaler at max. See runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/dedicated-latency
maria-ops: ack. paging @jason-sre and @li-eng. tagging customer success @olivia-customer-success for comms. starting war room.
jason-sre: i'm oncall and joining. opening terminal, tailing inference logs for pool tidal-eu1-dedicated. rough plan: 1) isolate tenant-tdc-42 traffic to throttle/circuit-breaker 2) trigger scaled-up warm-spare region 3) apply temporary model-variant routing for that tenant 4) monitor p99. assign tasks? oncall handoff to me for next 2h.
li-eng: quick metrics dump: GPU utilization on nodes in pool at 96-99%, queue latency growing, continuous-batching backlog rising. KV cache miss rate for pool up from 5% -> 42% in last 10m. Top callers show long-prefixed repeated prompts from tenant-tdc-42.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: jason-sre is primary for this incident until +2h. paging alerts set to minimal for non-responders.
olivia-customer-success: I spoke to TidalCorp PM (Lena). They've noticed slow responses in their EU region starting ~08:03 UTC. They asked for ETA and whether we'll isolate noisy tenants. I told them we're investigating and will provide updates every 15m.
akshay-sre: preparing isolation script. running:

```
/scripts/isolate_tenant.sh --tenant tenant-tdc-42 --pool tidal-eu1-dedicated --drain-seconds 30
```
Output: starting drain -> connections drained on 6/8 nodes, redirecting new sessions to tenant-tdc-42-escapes (throttle group). I'll post result when complete.
jason-sre: applying per-tenant throttle: set quota tenant-tdc-42 -> 20 rps and burst 50. also triggering scale up of pool (requesting 4 more GPU nodes) and enabling warm-spare failover to eu-north1. commands:
```
rictl pool scale tidal-eu1-dedicated --add-nodes 4
rictl routing set --tenant tenant-tdc-42 --route backup-model:quantized-small
```
pagerbot: Autoscaler accepted scaling request; provisioning nodes. Node provisioning events: new-gpu-34 provisioning, new-gpu-35 provisioning.
li-eng: after throttle + routing change: cache miss rate improving for others, but tenant-tdc-42 still causing KV eviction churn. suggest pinning top prefixes for this tenant:
```
cachectl pin tenant-tdc-42 --prefixes "[\"/chat/open\",\"/complete/priming\"]" --ttl 600
```
jason-sre: applied prefix pinning and routing. running real-time p99 check -> p99 dropped to ~360ms within 2m. p95 ~170ms. big improvement but heavy prompts still 500-700ms occasional.
olivia-customer-success: TidalCorp confirms latency reduced and some errors cleared. They reported one large batch job still seeing slower responses; it's coming from tenant-tdc-42 background job queue.
akshay-sre: observed one misbehaving task sending 1000 requests/min with long contexts. I've flagged the task and suggested they throttle its producer or shard it. Posting snippet of offending logs:
```
[2026-03-15T08:07:12Z] tenant=tenant-tdc-42 req_id=abc123 len=48k tokens processing_time=1.8s
[2026-03-15T08:07:13Z] tenant=tenant-tdc-42 req_id=abc124 len=50k tokens processing_time=2.4s
```
jason-sre: thanks. next steps: 1) keep tenant throttled to 20rps and route heavy requests to quantized-small variant for 1 hour; 2) finish node provisioning and balance KV cache warmup; 3) follow up with product on circuit-breaker rules for dedicated pools; 4) run post-incident review. tagging @akshay-sre to own follow-up on autoscaler thresholds.
oncall-bot: Incident severity updated -> Sev2 -> mitigation in progress. Notification cadence set to 15m.
li-eng: spinning up background task to pre-warm KV cache for new nodes and prefetch top prefixes for tenant-tdc-42. estimated 8m to stabilize.
jason-sre: p99 steady ~280-380ms over last 5m. marking customer impact: degraded (SLO breached earlier, now mitigated). please keep comms open with TidalCorp.
olivia-customer-success: passing interim update to Lena: "We've isolated noisy tenant activity, applied temporary throttles and model routing. Latency improved dramatically; we're monitoring. Will follow with full incident report." she replied :thumbsup:.
akshay-sre: nodes up and added to pool. balancing traffic. autoscaler logs show thresholds hit; we'll lower trigger threshold from 90%->75% for this pool as a short-term change.
jason-sre: documenting commands used and timeline. will open ticket RI-INC-243567 for full postmortem. items: autotuner for quantized routing, tenant isolation circuit-breaker, autoscaler thresholds, runbook updates for dedicated pools.
pagerbot: [RESOLVED] p99 back under threshold for 10m and traffic normalized. Incident cleared at 08:46 UTC. Creating follow-up task and incident record: https://console.internal/incidents/RI-INC-243567
maria-ops: nice work team. i'll schedule a 1h postmortem tomorrow to capture action items and owner assignments. thanks everyone. :heart:
